He set it on his windowsill beside the lamp, and that night, for the first time in years, he found himself watching the horizon not for weather, but for a sail he couldn't name.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，却照不出几个行人。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音格外清晰。远处偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯在湿漉漉的柏油路上拖出一道光。便利店的玻璃窗里，店员靠着柜台打哈欠，货架上的关东煮还冒着热气。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有极少几户还亮着灯，像是谁也没睡。风有点凉，吹过空荡的十字路口，带着一点昨夜的烧烤味和今晨的潮气。这座城市在喘息，等待天亮后重新热闹起来。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem.\nImagine Russian nesting dolls: to open the big doll, you open a smaller one inside, and that one has an even smaller one, until you reach the tiniest doll that just opens easily.\nThat tiniest doll is called the 'base case', and it's what stops the function from calling itself forever."}
